s.note: Mini pizza rounds, mozzarella, pepperoni. Two slices, says Serleena
s.how: Roll out 500g pizza dough and cut into 16 rounds. Spread each with a spoon of pizza sauce, then add grated mozzarella and a slice of pepperoni. Bake on a hot tray at 230C for 8 minutes until the bases are crisp and the cheese bubbles.

s.note: Pork and fennel sausage rolls, sauce
s.how: Heat the oven to 200°C and line two trays. Mix the pork, onion, fennel seeds, breadcrumbs, 1 egg and a good pinch of salt and pepper. Cut each pastry sheet in half. Lay a log of filling along each half, roll up and press the seam down underneath. Cut each roll into 4, brush with the other egg, beaten, and bake for 25 minutes until golden and cooked through. Serve hot with tomato sauce.

m.note: Thin crust pizza with crushed tomato, mozzarella and crumbled Italian sausage
m.how: Stretch 2 balls of cold-fermented dough, 500g in total, thin. Spread with 200g crushed tomato seasoned with salt. Top with 250g low-moisture mozzarella and 3 Italian sausages, skins off, crumbled. Bake on a steel at max heat for 7 minutes.

w.note: Cake doughnuts dipped in a sweet espresso glaze
w.how: Mix 200g icing sugar with 3 tbsp strong espresso and 10g melted butter until smooth. Dip the tops of 8 plain cake doughnuts and leave to set.

w.note: Chewy brown butter and brown sugar cookies, baked in small rounds
w.how: Brown 125g butter and cool. Beat with 150g brown sugar and 1 egg, then mix in 200g flour and half a tsp bicarb. Roll into 16 balls and bake at 180C for 10 minutes. Cool, then pipe pug faces on with 50g melted dark chocolate.

d.note: Espresso, vanilla ice cream, milk and caramel, topped with cream and gummy worms
d.how: Brew 4 espressos and cool for 10 minutes. Blend with 6 scoops vanilla ice cream, 300ml cold milk and 2 tbsp caramel sauce until thick and smooth. Whip 300ml thickened cream to soft peaks. Pour the shakes into 4 tall glasses, top with the cream and drizzle with a little more caramel. Hang 2 gummy worms over each rim.
